lines.zh: 我从高空落下来，翅膀没张开。
lines.en: I drop from high up without spreading wings.
I step over the fence.
My fingers hook the door frame.
I walk along the eaves.

lines.zh: 我踩在空气上，像踩石阶。
lines.en: I step on air as if on stairs.
I move faster by day than by night.
I avoid sunlight, keeping to the wall base.
I fly halfway through a step.
My shadow crawls on the wall.
I go step by step, counting doors.
I come down the chimney.

lines.zh: 我的脚踝很细，走起来无声。
lines.en: My ankles are thin; my steps are silent.
I crouch on the ridge, watching below.
I tilt my head like a bird.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有几处能下手。
lines.en: I'm counting the places on you I could strike.
I am listening for an unlatched door.

lines.zh: 风掀着我的衣角，我不动
lines.en: The wind tugs at my hem; I stay still.
I open my hands, then close them.
I crouch, waiting for you to push the door open.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙不动，也没有呼吸。
lines.en: My throat is still and I do not breathe.
I dangle my feet under the eaves.

lines.zh: 我在数这个村子有几头牛。
lines.en: I am counting the cattle here.
My eyes are not quite human.

lines.zh: 我的脖子转过来，身子还没转。
lines.en: My neck turns before my body does.
I count the tiles on the eaves.
I prop my feet on the beam.
I wait to see which window goes dark first.
My neck can turn to my back.
You finally looked up at the eaves.
I am on your roof.
Your door bar is not very sturdy.
I have stood outside your window.
Your cow bellowed fiercely last night.
I don't eat people; I eat livestock.
Don't run. You can't outrun me.
Your neck is very clean.
I have counted the people in your house.
There is a hole in your roof.
I reach out and can touch you.
I tilt my head the other way.
You stand under the eaves; I can reach you.
Your dog has gone quiet.
I retreat to the eaves.

lines.zh: 你把我从梁上打了下来
lines.en: You knock me down off the beam.
I have little blood left.
I land and sway.
I grit my teeth and look at the wound.
It hurts, but I can fly.

lines.zh: 我的一根指头挂在皮上。
lines.en: One of my fingers hangs by the skin.
I lean on the wall, panting.
You hit me once.
I fall back and reset.
I don't want that.

lines.zh: 你家的牛比较合我胃口。
lines.en: Your cow suits my appetite better.
Shut the door; I'll still get in.
I don't eat cooked food.
Bring the livestock out.
That is too small.

lines.zh: 你袖口那点血，我闻见了
lines.en: That smear of blood on your cuff — I smell it.
What are you guarding?
Move aside; I'm not after you.
Put out the lamp and I'll leave.

lines.zh: 你一头撞过来，我没退半分
lines.en: You charge into me and I do not give an inch.

lines.zh: 我骨头轻，撞上去只有一声响。
lines.en: My bones are light; a bump only clatters.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我却没感觉。
lines.en: You step on my foot; I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的发顶飞了过去
lines.en: I skim right over the top of your head.
My fingers graze your shoulder.
Don't grab me; I'll go up on the roof.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你退了两步。
lines.en: We collide and you give two steps.

lines.zh: 我擦着你的后颈滑到另一边
lines.en: I brush your nape and slide to your other side.

lines.zh: 你抓到的只是我的影子。
lines.en: You grabbed only my shadow.
I step aside and you run into me again.
The roof only holds one of me.
I hunt alone.
Don't come close; I bite.

lines.zh: 我这一族不会留下后代。
lines.en: My kind leaves no offspring.
Your scent makes me hungry.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，像看一块肉。
lines.en: I tilt my head, seeing meat.

lines.zh: 我把你当成猎物，不是伴侣。
lines.en: I see you as prey, not a mate.
When I smile, my teeth are long.
Don't reach under the eaves.
Don't touch the base of my wings.

lines.zh: 我用这个钩子撬得开木门
lines.en: With this hook I can pry open a wooden door.
I snatch it into my sleeve.
Too small to bother with.
I clip it to the belt at my waist.
This can pry a door.
I sniff it. Iron.
I pick it up, look, and drop it.
You dropped it? I took it.
I hold it in one hand.
I keep it for later.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就先解决你。
lines.en: You saw me, so you go first.
I swing down off the eaves.
Your door won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我数完屋檐上有几片瓦就动手。
lines.en: I finish counting the roof tiles, then strike.
Your livestock first, then you.

lines.zh: 我从屋脊翻下来，脚没出声
lines.en: I flip off the ridge and land without a sound.
Put down what you're holding.
I dislike being watched.
Raise the torch and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我饿得连牲口棚都盯上了。
lines.en: I'm hungry enough to eye the stock shed.
Your lamp can't reach the eaves.
I smile, teeth showing.

lines.zh: 我从这根梁跳到那根梁。
lines.en: I leap from beam to beam.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，我在下面。
lines.en: While you look up, I am below.
I have half-removed your door bar.
I wait for you to open it.
Your torch is turning this way.
I circle to the back of the house.
Have you counted the windows?

lines.zh: 我蹲在梁上，连气都不出
lines.en: Crouched on the beam, I do not even breathe.
I am on the beam above you.
Wherever you run, I fly faster.
My claws have already gripped.
Two more steps.

lines.zh: 你的火把只照到这一面墙。
lines.en: Your torch only lights this one wall.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐直直地落你背上
lines.en: I drop straight from the eaves onto your back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先落在你肩上。
lines.en: My claws land on your shoulder first.

lines.zh: 我的爪子找到你锁骨下面
lines.en: My claws find the spot below your collarbone.
I bite your wrist.

lines.zh: 你把我推开，我又贴上去。
lines.en: You push me off and I cling again.
I strike, and my wounds close.
The more I fight, the livelier I get.

lines.zh: 你的血流出来，我精神了。
lines.en: Your blood shows and I brighten.

lines.zh: 我的手指勾进你的衣领。
lines.en: My fingers hook your collar.
I am behind you.
I drop out of the sky.
The rooftops here are good.
I land on a beam, lightly.
I hear cattle below.
All the doors here are wood.
I counted; nightfall is still a while off.
First I retract my claws.
The wind holds me at the eaves.
I come up out of the ground.
These walls are low.

lines.zh: 我在屋脊上掰了掰手指
lines.en: On the rooftop ridge I crack my fingers.
I smell the stock shed.
I am looking for a gap to enter.
I stand and wait for the dark.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我跳开了。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve and I spring away.
I fell from the beam and wrenched my leg.
Water floods my throat and I fight upward.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我拍进屋墙
lines.en: The blast slams me into the cottage wall.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
Spell-light binds the base of my wings.
Hungry too long, I fly unsteadily.

lines.zh: 雷光打在我身上，我僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I seize up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往上拉，我挣不开。
lines.en: The void pulls me up and I cannot break free.
